severity: P0 — biased evidence loss on the first prospective slate

defect.what: FEE_POLICY['version'] = 'kalshi-fee-2026-07-general' is 26 chars; paper_fill.fee_policy_version was String(24)
defect.why_undetected: SQLite ignores VARCHAR(n) entirely and the whole test suite runs on SQLite; production is PostgreSQL, which raises StringDataRightTruncation
defect.production_error: (psycopg.errors.StringDataRightTruncation) value too long for type character varying(24) [SQL: INSERT INTO paper_fill ...]
defect.how_found: the paper-coverage backfill built to recover 18 missing legs reproduced the original failure verbatim on all 6 uncovered locks

why_the_loss_was_biased: paper_trade_lock wraps the whole lock in one transaction. A lock whose signals were ALL rejections inserted no paper_fill, so it committed normally. A lock that produced even one FILL hit the truncation, and the except-branch rollback discarded that lock's signals too. The ledger therefore retained 100% of rejections and 0% of fills.

consequence.actual: 6 of 15 locks produced at least one fill-grade signal and were erased; the surviving 27 are rejections BY SELECTION, not because the model agreed with the market
consequence.invalidated_claim: the paper module docstring asserts 'a rejected signal keeps its reason, so the ledger has no survivorship bias' — the ledger had maximal survivorship bias
consequence.prior_evaluation_statement_now_WRONG: 'the model never disagreed with the market by more than 3%' — it did, on at least 6 fixtures, and those are exactly the ones lost

remediation.migration_a1b2c3d4e5f6: widen 10 version/policy columns, incl. the two holding PROVIDER-controlled strings (market_quote.fee_schedule_version <- kalshi fee_type, lineup_snapshot.parser_version)
remediation.structural: tests now enforce VARCHAR lengths on SQLite via a before_flush listener, giving PostgreSQL-grade enforcement to every test that writes a row — this defect class can no longer pass a local run
remediation.invariant_tests: every versioned constant is checked against the column it is persisted in, on SQLite AND with a real PostgreSQL write
remediation.proof_the_guard_works: enabling the listener turned 10 previously green tests red — exactly the fill-creating ones

lesson: the project's recurring defect shape again: a correct implementation of an assumption never checked against reality. Here the assumption was 'the test database behaves like the production database'.
tests: 500 SQLite + 7 PostgreSQL integration green; chain round-trips empty->head->down->head on PG 18
